formatted_question:
According to the paper "Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion by Orthogonal Finetuning", the orthogonal matrices generated by the Cayley parameterization can have determinant
(A) either 1 or -1.
(B) 1.
(C) -1.
(D) a complex value with unit modulus.
(E) 0.
option_d: a complex value with unit modulus.
distractors: ["-1.", "either 1 or -1.", "0.", "a complex value with unit modulus."]
fact: According to the paper "Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion by Orthogonal Finetuning", the orthogonal matrices generated by the Cayley parameterization can have determinant 1.
raw_knowledge_statement: Such an efficiency comes at a small price -- the Cayley parameterization can only produce orthogonal matrices with determinant $1$ which belongs to the special orthogonal group.
